DPI maximum corrected 8200 -> 5700: libratbag's logitech-g700.device (0xC06B, wired) and logitech-g700-wireless.device (0xC531, receiver mode) both declare DpiRange=0:5700@23.53. 8200 is G700s's confirmed ceiling (logitech-g700s.device, 0xC07C, DpiRange=0:8200@50), not G700's -- the two figures appear to have been conflated between the sibling files.

Corrected 2026-09-17: relabeled records 8-13. Two official Logitech manuals (Getting Started guide, Features guide) give a numbered G-legend: G8=Battery check, G9=DPI down, G10=DPI up, G11=Profile switch, and 'Hyperfast scroll wheel with tilt (G3, G12, G13)' for the wheel-tilt pair. Only records 6/7 remain genuinely generic/unlabeled thumb buttons -- this was the single highest-confidence finding of the whole legacy-button verification pass, since 6 of the 8 previously-generic 'Side/top button' slots have long-documented, specific official functions.
